County tools help identify the district; the district confirms the school and placement.

Cupertino：Cupertino Union（CUSD）的初等阶段查询不能: Cupertino: Cupertino Union’s (CUSD) elementary-level locator does not replace a high-school lookup. For high school, separately use Fremont Union High School District’s (FUHSD) Address Check Tool.
Sunnyvale：Sunnyvale School District 的注册与: Sunnyvale: Sunnyvale School District enrollment and FUHSD high-school enrollment are separate, but not every Sunnyvale address belongs to these districts. Cross-check the county directory and the relevant district tools first.
提交后继续跟进学校分配: Follow up on placement after submitting
按正确学年的清单准备材料，线上提交或询问现场协助，并保存回执。SJUSD 明确须: Prepare the documents listed for the correct school year, submit online or request in-person help, and save the receipt. SJUSD states that enrollment is complete only after requirements are met and staff send confirmation; ask other districts about review status, assigned school, and attendance arrangements too. Interdistrict and intradistrict transfers have their own processes, so ask about release, acceptance, and waiting lists. Do not assume finishing middle school automatically completes high-school enrollment.
新来家庭可问英语学习者评估、翻译、辅导员会面，以及原校成绩和学习支持计划的转交方: Newcomer families can ask about English learner assessment, interpretation, counselor meetings, and secure transfer of prior records and learning-support plans. For a midyear move, confirm course continuity, especially high-school credits and schedules. Ask both schools to explain the transition before assuming the receiving arrangements are complete.
看校与大学探索都从官网预约: Arrange school visits and college exploration through official sites
用 SCCOE 目录打开学校官网，联系办公室了解可预约的参访；重点问课程、课后项: Open school websites through the SCCOE directory and ask the office about available visits. Focus on courses, after-school capacity and fees, daily transportation, and a contact for new students. SJSU has separate admissions and campus-visit resources. At Foothill College, review application steps, then locate the office and campus map. College applications depend on student type, term, and program; K–12 residential assignment does not apply, and visiting does not reserve admission.
地址只填官方入口: Enter addresses only through official channels
在官方查询器中输入完整居住地址；不要在公开提问、社区帖或本网站提交孩子姓名、出生: Enter your full residential address in the official locator. Do not post a child’s name, date of birth, home address, or documents in public questions, community posts, or this website. Ask the district about alternative verification and assistance if documents are missing or you share housing or have temporary accommodation.
